negative_snippets: My experience at Magpie Tourist Resort was adequate. The facilities were present, and I found the overall environment to be acceptable. However, there were a few aspects that could be improved upon to enhance the stay.
Recently me and my team visit magpie resort for a wedding shoot. The rooms was way to short for 2 people, the stairs was covered in dust. And lighting condition was very dull
Washroom were dirty, All sanitary fittings were hanging, There was no mosquito repellent in the room.
